description: On startup and after /clear, hands the new session the previous one's context (startup directory, last prompt, last message or actions, handoff documents, recently edited files) and the standing rule to keep a living handoff. On resume and after compaction, one sentence asking the session to load the save skill. On /clear the ending session leaves a marker so the new one reads exactly the cleared transcript. On each prompt, a session that never received any of that (plugin installed while it was running) gets the same sentence once.
